_note: C15-R2 frozen thresholds (D73; D74 additions marked 'D74'). The c15a2 package must load and assert these values; any difference fails its tests. Unchanged A-stage criteria are marked 'unchanged'.

W0a.status: unchanged; validity requirement for every claim

W0b_prime.status: positions per Biran 2024 / Yang 2024; thresholds unchanged; foil lift added (stricter)

D74_decision_rule.multiplicity: none (single pre-declared primary position; t1/t2 have no role in any gate, pattern or claim)
D74_decision_rule.gate: two_hop_acc >= 0.60 AND rate_td >= 0.40 AND lift_td >= 0.20 AND one-sided 95% item-bootstrap (2000) lower bound of lift_td > 0; rates among correct items
D74_decision_rule.hit: any alias first token in J-lens top-20 at any band layer at td (band-layer union unchanged; applied identically to the 5 foils)

D74_complete_gate_null_calibration.worst_config: offset-decay, 132 sites, rho 0.5, sigma_m 1.0, floor 0.30, isotropic

D74_matched_coverage.rule: <=1 unmatched -> drop it from both arms (K'=7, chance 1/7); >=2 -> not assessable

D74_controls.PC1: median over concepts cos(F_p1, F_p2) >= 0.5 at >= 50% of downstream sites
D74_controls.PC2: acc_nat >= 0.30 and binomial p < 0.05 at >= 50% of downstream sites
D74_controls.PC3: offset 0 at layer l+2 vs offset-0 paraphrase references: J or perp acc >= 0.30 and p < 0.05
D74_controls.NC1: deterministic norm-matched random unit directions at a*h: BB <= 0.10
D74_controls.NC2: J effects with a fixed derangement of labels (design seed): BB <= 0.10
D74_controls.NC3_LEI: mean over downstream sites of acc_J(word refs) - acc_J(paraphrase refs); reported only

D74.suffix: In the text above, the hidden object was the

W5.SI_norm: always reported; mandated wording if SI_iso passes and SI_norm > 1

unchanged_procedures: matched-perp construction (empirical KL x/1.15, lens gain, propagation)
materials sizes per split for W0-W2, W4-W5

powered_failure._rule: A failed gate counts as evidence of absence only if (i) its assay-validity controls pass in that cell AND (ii) the 95% CI lies entirely outside the pass region AND (iii) the point estimate is outside the pass region by the margin below.

D74_ci_for_powered_failure.W4: two-hop items (paired J vs random scale 1)

D74_classification.group_powered_failure: at least one member gate has a powered failure
D74_classification.assay_valid_cell: W0a(model) AND W3' PC1,PC2,PC3,NC1,NC2 pass AND W1, W2 frac_unmatched <= 0.20
D74_classification.model_coverage_P3_P0: model counts only if W0a passes and >= 50% of its band layers are assay-valid
D74_classification.P1_choice: unchanged A-stage CHOOSE rule with W3 -> W3' and W0 = W0a AND W0b'
D74_classification.P2_pair: maximise min(min margin of A at X, min margin of B at Y); X, Y in different models; ties smaller model for X, then lower layers
D74_classification.P3_representative: largest W4 margin among the qualifying model's assay-valid layers
D74_classification.P0_representative: most negative max(margin_W1, margin_W2, margin_W3') among assay-valid cells; ties smaller model, lower layer
